sdc.daemon.RouteSource.title: RouteSource
sdc.daemon.RouteSource.description: The setting that chose a run's route: run (the submit named it, `model_route` or `model_routes.<role>`) or default (the submit named none and the daemon's `route_policy.default` applied; a daemon whose file declares no route but a lone `[gateway]` table and a model decider declares the interim route `default` on that gateway and takes it as its default, so a model run that names none says default too). The protocol's own word comes with its story.
